metadata.name: Cancel a reminder
metadata.description: Use “Cancel a reminder” in Recued. Withdraw a reminder still to ring, so it never rings. Take its id from My reminders. A reminder that has already rung stays as it was.
metadata.author: recued-core

reminder_id.label: Reminder id
reminder_id.help: The reminder to cancel, as My reminders lists it (rem_…).
